title: while only a background subagent works, a message joins the turn and the agent answers it, and the subagent shows done once it ends, before its turn does
reason: On the Windows runner the scripted Agent call is not reported as a background launch, so its card never says in the background; it failed once in the 0.13.0 run and all three tries in 0.14.0's, while the Mac passes it every run.
